statement: This verdict OVERWRITES the Board 8 bar of the same name (written 2026-09-23T20:36:32.716Z, 13 of 13 checks, MET); its 13 checks run here first, unchanged. In a copied tree holding the real gate program (bench/gate.mjs 15ceb8e82194) a planted fix was KEPT with the gate going from exit 1 to exit 0, a planted patch that turned test/area.test.mjs red was REVERTED byte for byte on a CRLF file, and a patch aimed at a test file was refused at the ceiling. On the real tree, brain self-code --auto --dry --json read 72 candidates by source (gate 0, notes 44, imagine 1, census 23, slow 4, mutants 0), would apply 0, and wrote nothing. One wet CLI pass on a planted repository copy with the model author off kept 2 candidates from non-mutant sources (imagine and census) with the gate GREEN and appended 2 lines to state/self/authored.jsonl with the gate hash before and after. The model cell qwen3:30b-a3b through Ollama was asked 1 time for a planted OPEN: line, answered in 34498 ms, and its patch was KEPT with the gate GREEN. Over the wet copy and the real docs/BOARDS.json the share is 2/95. 21 of 21 checks passed.
